title: Quietly Smoky Australian Tamarind Skewers
description: A cozy Australian dish featuring tamarind pulp, grilled to perfection with a smoky flavor, this recipe is nut-free-friendly and perfect for a dinner gathering.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat.
In a blender, combine tamarind pulp, olive oil, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Thread the pork or beef onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the tamarind mixture onto both sides of the meat.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Let the skewers rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Reheat leftovers to an internal temperature of 165 degrees before serving.
